bit_exact_detail: Every output hash (GEMM outputs, projection logits, greedy (max, index) pairs, certified-screen pairs, split-K outputs) is equal across all four runs of both arms in every cell, and across the two TILE_CONFIGS[128] variants: 0 ULP.
reason: The packed vocab projection and greedy-partials kernels are much faster (2.4-3.8x at the PR's 0.35% exception density; 15-20% at the 128-row tile at natural density) and compressor_up's packed GEMM is faster at every M (1.02-1.11x), all bit-exact. But the mark includes the certified screen, and that path, which serving's greedy verification takes, is slower beyond the interval at M=97..120 on TP4 (0.6-2.6% by graph replay; the rows c16 with CopyDrafter replays, 104 and 112), corroborated at natural density by #1001's bench (0.3-1.4%). Two of the PR's own four GEMM shapes are also slower at every M (compressor_down 512x10240 2.5-7.4%, indexer_wk 128x5120 2-3%, also by isolated kernel time), although packed_bf16_gemm has no serving caller; and the split-K compressor GEMM that serving runs shows no gain. Rework: keep the vocab projection/greedy-partials changes, find why the screen's refine kernel (which calls the rewritten vllm_vocab_decode_vec16) loses at 97..120 rows, and check pdl.chain()/the row-bounds change on the narrow packed GEMMs.
